name: ClickHouse
about: The newest release on each ClickHouse server line that ClickHouse still supports with security updates, for self-managed open-source ClickHouse. ClickHouse Cloud is patched by ClickHouse.
older: ClickHouse's security policy lists 26.11, 26.10, 26.9 and the LTS lines 26.8 and 26.3 as supported. Other lines, such as 26.7 and everything from 25.x back, get no security fixes: upgrade to a supported line.
